items.prompt: If previous ending=-2 and the current value is 3, which new ending follows the recurrence?

options.why: Restarting at 3 is better than extending the prior loss to 1.

options.text: 3, by restarting at the current item.
options.why: max(3,-2+3)=3 preserves a best nonempty interval ending here.
The ending state is expressly nonempty.

options.text: 5, by subtracting the negative previous state.
options.why: The recurrence adds an adjacent interval; it does not subtract its sum.
